text: The app icon is too ugly. Going back to an app where habits grow in a form of plants in the same window. In this I lack the overview and I am realizing that I'm getting worse at my habits. Not a bad app, but not worth it. In the free version you are limited to the amount of habits you can add... not enough for moi.
